svg.title: Urchin — QWERTY Miryoku, all seven layers
svg.desc: 34 physical keys. Same-hand two-thumb chords replace tertiary thumbs. Base: left chord Escape/Media, right chord Delete/Fun. Layer-specific chords are listed on every panel. Release both members to release a chord.
svg.metadata: keyboard.toml normalized-LF sha256: e951dbbb60be191d7ae5685df75fc29ab8c209e629f873c2205e17cb4e56d8c4; Modus Operandi palette; schematic placement; generated by assets/generate-keymap.py.
svg.text: 34 keys · two thumbs per hand · US symbols · large legend: tap · lower legend: hold
Thumb chord: press within 50 ms · hold 200 ms for layer · release BOTH keys to release output
